name: Safe Web
source:
Hello! I am Beata!
Your favorite virtual assistant!
Do you like the Web like I do? I'm sure you do! After all, it's a place where people connect and share their stories, and post cute photos of their cats!

But I'm sure you've also noticed that it can be a dangerous and upsetting place sometimes. Well, not anymore! My friends and I fixed it for you! From now on, there are going to be no more explicit materials, no more violent content, and no more negative emotions!

The best part? You'll get your own Beata for FREE! I'm going to watch over you forever! Together, we will make sure the Web stays a safe haven for everyone!

[From [url=https://madval.itch.io/safe-web-game]itch.io[/url]]
